verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants use its search and reasoning tools. It comes as a recommended remote server hosted at https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp (no installation) or as an open-source local stdio server, with tool-restriction controls and a separate Computer MCP server for delegating multi-step work. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably through the MCP server, and detail on the specific tools it exposes.
